texts.edit: Privilege guardrail: this edit changes the `env` of {{path}}, a harness settings file. The launcher sets the run's actor there (AKMON_ACTOR), so an agent never writes the `env` of a harness settings file. If the change is genuinely needed, ask the owner to make it themselves.
